investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (985) was observed from Tallinn, Estonia, at 23:55 UTC, far exceeding the 24-hour baseline of 50. Downloads targeted confidential documents on the Strategy and Growth site via Office 365 SharePoint Online, including Project_Phoenix_Acquisition_Terms_Draft.pdf, Q1_Strategic_Market_Exit_Plan.docx, and Board_Member_Private_Contact_List.xlsx. The user is a Maintenance Technician, a role mismatch for this data access, and the late-night timing with high data volume suggests potential data exfiltration or a compromised account, warranting HP classification.
